# Sandbank

> Sandbank is a unified sandbox SDK for AI agents. One TypeScript interface for Daytona, Fly.io, Cloudflare and more: write once, run on any cloud. Sandbank Cloud provides managed sandbox hosting so you can skip the infra. Open source.

## Links

- [Website and console](https://sandbank.dev/)
- [Source code (GitHub)](https://github.com/chekusu/sandbank)
